clause: Auto-layout advanced: absolute-position exclusion, stroke-in-spacing, deep nesting, convert-to-auto-layout [STU-DS-044,STU-DS-045]

scope.summary: Implement advanced auto-layout: excluding individual children from the flow (ignore-auto-layout / absolute position) while keeping them inside the frame under constraint-based positioning (MT-362) for overlays such as badges; an advanced setting choosing whether child stroke weights count in spacing; arbitrarily deep nesting of auto-layout frames combining per-level direction/gap/padding/resizing; and a convert-to-auto-layout command (optionally assisted) restructuring a plain frame's contents into an equivalent auto-layout structure as ordinary local StudioDocument state.
expected_tests: argus: convert-to-auto-layout command + advanced controls reachable via author_id
test: absolute-position child excluded from flow but framed; stroke-in-spacing toggle; deep nesting; convert restructures a plain frame
acceptance_criteria_original: absolute-position exclusion + stroke-in-spacing + deep nesting + convert-to-auto-layout; author_id + manual entry

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-DS-044] Individual children MUST be excludable from the flow (ignore-auto-layout / absolute position), remaining inside the frame under constraint-based positioning ([STU-DS-046]) for overlays such as notification badges.

[STU-DS-045] `StudioAutoLayout` MUST additionally support: an advanced setting choosing whether child stroke weights count in spacing calculations, and arbitrarily deep nesting of auto-layout frames combining per-level direction/gap/padding/resizing to express complete responsive component trees. A convert-to-auto-layout command (optionally assisted) MAY restructure a plain frame's contents into an equivalent auto-layout structure; the result is ordinary local `StudioDocument` state. ### 9. Constraints (StudioConstraint) Constraints handle responsive positioning for children that are not in an auto-layout flow: they pin or scale a child as its parent frame resizes. Constraints and auto layout are mutually exclusive per axis for a given child ([STU-DS-048]).

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.
